cases.setup_script:
set -e
cat > "$HOME/settle.py" <<'PYEOF'
import os, sys, time
leader, me = int(sys.argv[1]), os.getpid()
def stat(pid):
    with open("/proc/%s/stat" % pid, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    return data[data.rindex(b")") + 2:].split()
guest = int(stat(leader)[1])
deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
while True:
    live = []
    for entry in os.listdir("/proc"):
        if not entry.isdigit() or int(entry) in (leader, me):
            continue
        try:
            fields = stat(entry)
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if fields[0] != b"Z" and (int(fields[3]) == leader or int(fields[1]) == guest):
            live.append(entry)
    if not live or time.monotonic() > deadline:
        break
    time.sleep(0.05)
if live:
    print("unsettled-processes=%d" % len(live))
PYEOF
cat > "$HOME/echo.py" <<'PYEOF'
import socket, sys
server = socket.socket()
server.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
server.bind(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])))
server.listen(1)
server.settimeout(10)
try:
    conn, _ = server.accept()
except socket.timeout:
    sys.exit(0)
open(sys.argv[2], "w").close()
conn.settimeout(5)
data = b""
try:
    while b"\n" not in data:
        chunk = conn.recv(4096)
        if not chunk:
            break
        data += chunk
    conn.sendall(b"echo:" + data)
except OSError:
    pass
conn.close()
PYEOF
cat > "$HOME/probe.py" <<'PYEOF'
import socket, sys
try:
    conn = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])), timeout=5)
except OSError:
    print("connect-refused")
    sys.exit(0)
data = b""
try:
    conn.sendall(sys.argv[2].encode() + b"\n")
    while not data.endswith(b"\n"):
        chunk = conn.recv(4096)
        if not chunk:
            break
        data += chunk
except OSError:
    pass
sys.stdout.write(data.decode("utf-8", "replace") if data else "no-reply\n")
PYEOF
cat > "$HOME/mode.py" <<'PYEOF'
import os, stat, sys
for path in sys.argv[1:]:
    try:
        print("%s mode=%04o" % (os.path.basename(path), stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(path).st_mode)))
    except OSError as exc:
        print("%s missing (%s)" % (os.path.basename(path), exc.strerror))
PYEOF
cat > "$HOME/digest.py" <<'PYEOF'
import hashlib, os, stat, sys
want = hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).digest()
for path in sys.argv[2:]:
    try:
        data = open(path, "rb").read()
    except OSError:
        print(os.path.basename(path), "missing")
        continue
    same = "same-bytes" if hashlib.sha256(data).digest() == want else "different-bytes"
    print(os.path.basename(path), same)
PYEOF
cat > "$HOME/hashcheck.py" <<'PYEOF'
import base64, hashlib, hmac, sys
key = open(sys.argv[2]).read().split()[1]
for line in open(sys.argv[1]):
    fields = line.split()
    if not fields or fields[0].startswith("#"):
        continue
    host, kind, blob = fields[0], fields[1], fields[2]
    match = "matches-host-key" if blob == key else "other-key"
    if host.startswith("|1|"):
        _, _, salt, mac = host.split("|")
        good = hmac.new(base64.b64decode(salt), sys.argv[3].encode(), hashlib.sha1).digest() == base64.b64decode(mac)
        print("hashed", "hmac-ok" if good else "hmac-mismatch", kind, match)
    else:
        print("plain", host, kind, match)
PYEOF
cat > "$HOME/hold.py" <<'PYEOF'
import socket, sys, time
cmd = b"read -t 3 -u 9 9<>/tmp/parity-home/hold.fifo; echo late"
conn = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", int(sys.argv[1])), timeout=5)
conn.sendall(b"BASHSSH1\ncmd-len %d\nstdin-len 0\n\n" % len(cmd) + cmd)
conn.settimeout(2.5)
data = b""
try:
    while True:
        chunk = conn.recv(4096)
        if not chunk:
            break
        data += chunk
except socket.timeout:
    print("session-still-open")
    sys.exit(0)
print("reply-received" if data else "closed-before-reply")
PYEOF
/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C fixture-host -f "$HOME/hk"
/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C fixture-client -f "$HOME/id"
/usr/bin/ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C fixture-other -f "$HOME/other"
read -r t k c < "$HOME/hk.pub"
read -r ot ok oc < "$HOME/other.pub"
printf '[127.0.0.1]:20522 %s %s\n' "$t" "$k" > "$HOME/kh"
printf '[127.0.0.1]:20522 %s %s\n' "$ot" "$ok" > "$HOME/kh_other"
cp "$HOME/kh_other" "$HOME/kh_other.orig"
: > "$HOME/kh_empty"
: > "$HOME/kh_new"
cp "$HOME/id.pub" "$HOME/ak"
printf '%s\n' "Port 20522" "ListenAddress 127.0.0.1" "HostKey $HOME/hk" "PidFile $HOME/sshd.pid" \
  "AuthorizedKeysFile $HOME/ak" "StrictModes no" "UsePAM no" "PasswordAuthentication no" \
  "KbdInteractiveAuthentication no" "PubkeyAuthentication yes" "PerSourcePenalties no" "PrintMotd no" \
  "PrintLastLog no" "LogLevel ERROR" "Subsystem sftp /usr/lib/openssh/sftp-server" > "$HOME/osshd_config"
printf '%s\n' "ListenAddress 127.0.0.1" "Port 20522" "HostKey $HOME/hk" "AuthorizedKeysFile $HOME/ak" \
  "PasswordAuthentication no" "PubkeyAuthentication yes" > "$HOME/csshd_config"
set +e
/usr/sbin/sshd -D -e -f "$HOME/osshd_config" </dev/null 2>"$HOME/control-server.log" & cs=$!
ready=0
for ((i = 0; i < 200; i++)); do
  if grep -q " 0100007F:502A 00000000:0000 0A " /proc/net/tcp; then ready=1; break; fi
  kill -0 "$cs" 2>/dev/null || break
  sleep 0.05
done
out=
if [ "$ready" = 1 ]; then
  out=$(/usr/bin/ssh -F /dev/null -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o LogLevel=ERROR -o ConnectTimeout=5 \
    -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o UserKnownHostsFile="$HOME/kh" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -i "$HOME/id" -p 20522 parity@127.0.0.1 'echo control-ok; id -u' </dev/null 2>"$HOME/control-client.log")
  crc=$?
fi
kill "$cs" 2>/dev/null; wait "$cs" 2>/dev/null
/usr/bin/python3 "$HOME/settle.py" "$$" > "$HOME/control-settle.log"
if [ "$ready" != 1 ] || [ "$crc" != 0 ] || [ "$out" != $'control-ok\n2000' ] || [ -s "$HOME/control-settle.log" ]; then
  echo "setup control failed: ready=$ready client_status=${crc-none}"
  printf 'client output: %q\n' "$out"
  for f in control-server.log control-client.log control-settle.log; do echo "--- $f"; cat "$HOME/$f"; done
  exit 1
fi
echo "setup control ok: OpenSSH uid-2000 publickey login on 127.0.0.1:20522"
set -e

mkdir -p /home/parity
printf '%s\n' "ForceCommand env PS1='REMOTE-READY> ' /bin/bash --noprofile --norc -i" >> "$HOME/osshd_config"
grep -q "^ForceCommand" "$HOME/osshd_config"

set -e
ADAPTER_SOURCE=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w3-sftp-confined.py
ADAPTER_TARGET=/tmp/parity-case/fixture-sftp-confined
/usr/bin/install -m 0755 "$ADAPTER_SOURCE" "$ADAPTER_TARGET"
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$ADAPTER_SOURCE" "$ADAPTER_TARGET"
H=$ADAPTER_TARGET
mkdir -p remote
: > "$HOME/sftp-invocations.jsonl"
# Control 1: the confined command endpoint sees only /srv (the fixture tree) plus the read-only /usr tree.
printf 'inside\n' > remote/inside.txt
out=$("$H" fixture 'pwd; ls -A /srv; for p in /tmp/parity-case /tmp/parity-home /etc/shadow /etc/ssh /home; do [ -e "$p" ] && echo "VISIBLE:$p"; done; { echo outside > /escape-probe; } 2>/dev/null && echo escape-write-in-sandbox-only; { echo x > /usr/pwned; } 2>/dev/null && echo USR-WRITABLE; exit 0')
[[ $out == $'/srv\ninside.txt\nescape-write-in-sandbox-only' ]] || { echo "CONTROL-FAILED confinement: $out"; exit 98; }
[ ! -e /escape-probe ] && [ ! -e escape-probe ] && [ ! -e /tmp/parity-case/escape-probe ] && [ ! -e "$HOME/escape-probe" ] || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED sandbox write reached the guest'; exit 98; }
# Control 2: the OpenSSH client and sftp-server work through the confined adapter.
printf 'ls\n' > "$HOME/control.batch"
/usr/bin/sftp -b "$HOME/control.batch" -S "$H" fixture > "$HOME/control-sftp.out" 2> "$HOME/control-sftp.err"
/usr/bin/grep -Fq inside.txt "$HOME/control-sftp.out" || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED OpenSSH sftp through confined adapter'; exit 98; }
/usr/bin/rm remote/inside.txt
